# LOPUO Studio — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Overview

## 1. Organization Architecture
- **Brand Name**: LOPUO Studio (由 LOPUO INFO 提供技术与研发支持)
- **Primary Mission**: Creating focused, high-precision software tools that solve specific operational and design bottlenecks for creators and modern businesses.
- **Domain Structure**:
  - `lopuo.com`: Agency and enterprise solutions division. Specializes in customized website construction (建站服务), bespoke software development (定制应用开发), cloud deployment architectures, and maintenance support.
  - `lopuo.work`: Product showcase portal (自研 SaaS 产品矩阵与落地页). Aggregates and showcases all self-developed products engineered by the studio.

---

## 2. Product Matrix Details

### HoleSnap (holesnap.com)
- **Tagline**: Vector patterns, fabrication-ready.
- **Target Audience**: Architectural designers, industrial designers, CNC machinists, sheet metal fabricators, interior architects, and makers.
- **Technical Specs**:
  - Computational geometry engine running client-side via WebAssembly/Canvas/SVG.
  - Generates exact vector geometries with zero interpolation artifacts.
  - Mathematical hole packing algorithms: Hexagonal, Triangular, Orthogonal grid, and Organic flow fields.
  - Real-time engineering telemetry: Pitch calculation (mm/in), Open area percentage, Bridge width clearance, and Weight estimation.
  - File Exports:
    - SVG: Clean vector paths with layer organization for graphic and laser software (LightBurn, Illustrator).
    - DXF: AutoCAD R12/R14 compliant line and polyline geometries ready for CNC waterjet/laser cutting machines.
    - STP/STEP: 3D solids for SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Rhino, and AutoCAD.

### ZIDER (zider.ink)
- **Tagline**: Components that power creator sites.
- **Target Audience**: Content creators, podcasters, digital marketers, agency developers, and site owners on no-code platforms.
- **Technical Specs**:
  - Zero-dependency web components and script tags.
  - Cross-platform compatibility: Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, and Ghost.
  - Components include:
    - Custom audio/podcast player with animated equalizers and chapter markers.
    - Interactive pricing calculators and ROI estimation sliders.
    - Dark mode toggles with localStorage persistence.
    - Micro-feedback widgets and floating social proof notifications.

### Zirwork (zirwork.com)
- **Tagline**: Operations that adapt to you.
- **Target Audience**: E-commerce merchants, digital agencies, distributors, and growing teams seeking an alternative to bloated legacy ERPs.
- **Technical Specs**:
  - Configurable entity models: Products, SKUs, Warehouses, Purchase Orders, Sales Orders, and Invoices.
  - Event-driven automation: When order status changes, automatically triggers inventory reservation, webhook notification, and invoicing.
  - Multi-tenant cloud infrastructure with end-to-end encryption.
  - Real-time telemetry dashboard with sub-second synchronization latency.

---

## 3. Technology Stack & Design Principles
- **Design Language**: Swiss international typographic style meets tactile brutalist minimalism. High contrast, precise hairline borders, refined typography, and purposeful motion.
- **Frontend Core**: Standards-compliant Semantic HTML5, CSS Variables, and modular Vanilla JS for maximum speed and zero dependencies.
- **Global Delivery**: Deployed globally across Cloudflare Workers & Pages edge nodes with zero cold-start latency.
